title: Activation of the transcription factor NFAT5 in the tumor microenvironment enforces CD8(+) T cell exhaustion.
authors: Tille, Laure; Cropp, Daniela; Charmoy, Melanie; Reichenbach, Patrick; Andreatta, Massimo; Wyss, Tania; Bodley, Gabrielle; Crespo, Isaac; Nassiri, Sina; Lourenco, Joao; Leblond, Marine M; Lopez-Rodriguez, Cristina; Speiser, Daniel E; Coukos, George; Irving, Melita; Carmona, Santiago J; Held, Werner; Verdeil, Gregory
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肿瘤微环境中转录因子NFAT5对CD8+ T细胞耗竭的调控，属于免疫学功能研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Persistent exposure to antigen during chronic infection or cancer renders T cells dysfunctional. The molecular mechanisms regulating this state of exhaustion are thought to be common in infection and cancer, despite obvious differences in their microenvironments. Here we found that NFAT5, an NFAT family transcription factor that lacks an AP-1 docking site, was highly expressed in exhausted CD8(+) T cells in the context of chronic infections and tumors but was selectively required in tumor-induced CD8(+) T cell exhaustion. Overexpression of NFAT5 in CD8(+) T cells reduced tumor control, while deletion of NFAT5 improved tumor control by promoting the accumulation of tumor-specific CD8(+) T cells that had reduced expression of the exhaustion-associated proteins TOX and PD-1 and produced more cytokines, such as IFNɣ and TNF, than cells with wild-type levels of NFAT5, specifically in the precursor exhausted PD-1(+)TCF1(+)TIM-3(-)CD8(+) T cell population. NFAT5 did not promote T cell exhaustion during chronic infection with clone 13 of lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus. Expression of NFAT5 was induced by TCR triggering, but its transcriptional activity was specific to the tumor microenvironment and required hyperosmolarity. Thus, NFAT5 promoted the exhaustion of CD8(+) T cells in a tumor-selective fashion.
abstract_zh: 在慢性感染或癌症期间持续暴露于抗原会使T细胞功能失调。调控这种耗竭状态的分子机制被认为在感染和癌症中是共通的，尽管它们的微环境存在明显差异。在此，我们发现NFAT5，一种缺乏AP-1对接位点的NFAT家族转录因子，在慢性感染和肿瘤背景下高度表达于耗竭的CD8(+) T细胞中，但仅在肿瘤诱导的CD8(+) T细胞耗竭中被选择性需求。在CD8(+) T细胞中过表达NFAT5降低了肿瘤控制能力，而删除NFAT5则通过促进肿瘤特异性CD8(+) T细胞的积累改善了肿瘤控制，这些细胞中耗竭相关蛋白TOX和PD-1的表达降低，并且比具有野生型NFAT5水平的细胞产生更多细胞因子，如IFNɣ和TNF，特别是在前体耗竭的PD-1(+)TCF1(+)TIM-3(-)CD8(+) T细胞群体中。NFAT5在淋巴细胞性脉络丛脑膜炎病毒克隆13慢性感染期间并未促进T细胞耗竭。NFAT5的表达由TCR触发诱导，但其转录活性对肿瘤微环境具有特异性，并需要高渗性。因此，NFAT5以肿瘤选择性方式促进了CD8(+) T细胞的耗竭。
